sources.name: CISA Known Exploited Vulnerabilities
sources.question: Which vulnerabilities are listed as known exploited?
sources.limitation: Not a complete inventory of all exploitation, and inclusion criteria can change.

sources.name: NVD Vulnerabilities API
sources.question: Where can I find CVE metadata and API documentation?
sources.limitation: Enrichment timing can lag CVE publication; it does not establish active exploitation.

sources.name: Exploit Prediction Scoring System
sources.question: Where can I find estimated near-term exploitation probabilities?
sources.limitation: EPSS is a predictive model, not confirmation that exploitation occurred.

sources.name: MITRE ATT&CK
sources.question: Where are documented adversary tactics and techniques classified?
sources.limitation: A technique mapping is not proof of an incident in a specific environment.

sources.name: OWASP Cheat Sheet Series
sources.question: Where can I find practical defensive implementation guidance?
sources.limitation: Guidance must be adapted to actual software, deployment and threat model.

sources.name: NIST Cybersecurity Framework
sources.question: Where can I review the official NIST Cybersecurity Framework for governing and communicating cybersecurity risk?
sources.limitation: The Cybersecurity Framework is distinct from the NIST Risk Management Framework. Neither catalogue selection nor a framework mapping proves certification, an audit or regulatory compliance.

sources.name: AWS IAM documentation
sources.question: Where is AWS's official IAM identity and permissions guidance?
sources.limitation: Check the service, account scope and latest applicable policies before implementation.

sources.name: Microsoft Entra authentication
sources.question: Where can I investigate Entra authentication and MFA concepts?
sources.limitation: Tenant licensing, configuration and feature availability can differ.

sources.name: MDN HTTP status codes
sources.question: What does this HTTP response code mean?
sources.limitation: An explanatory secondary reference, not the normative HTTP specification. A status code alone does not reveal server root cause.

sources.name: HTTP Semantics RFC 9110
sources.question: What are standard HTTP method, header and status semantics?
sources.limitation: Check updates and related specifications for the exact use case.

sources.name: Cloudflare Cache documentation
sources.question: How do Cloudflare caching and revalidation work?
sources.limitation: Behaviour depends on the zone, rules and plan.

sources.name: Eurostat official statistics
sources.question: Where can I obtain European official statistics and their methodology?
sources.limitation: Check dataset-specific definitions, units, geography, seasonal adjustment, release timing, revisions and reuse terms. Official publication does not make unlike series comparable.

selection_method: Choose the publisher responsible for the claim. Prefer original data, vendor documentation and normative specifications; MDN and OWASP are labelled reference or community guidance. Selection is by the question answered, not popularity, payment or crawler traffic.

workflows.title: Defensive triage: three signals, three different claims
workflows.question: How should I investigate a CVE without confusing observed exploitation, severity and predicted risk?
steps: Record the exact CVE, affected product/version and the time of your review. Confirm exposure and the fix in the original vendor advisory; a catalogue match cannot establish local exposure.

Check CISA KEV for inclusion and record the catalogue entry and date. Inclusion supports a known-exploitation claim; absence does not establish that exploitation is impossible or unobserved elsewhere.
Use NVD for CVE references and available enrichment. Keep CVSS severity, affected-version assertions and enrichment timestamps distinct from exploitation evidence.
Record the FIRST EPSS score, score date and percentile separately. Its next-30-day probability is a model estimate, not proof that your organisation has been targeted.
Write the decision with source URLs, retrieval times, local exposure and unresolved gaps. CyberDailyLog can help organise that review; an analyst still decides whether to escalate.
workflows.do_not_infer: Do not convert a KEV absence, a high CVSS score or an EPSS probability into a confirmed incident, a guaranteed forecast or a safe-to-ignore verdict.
workflows.project_connection: CyberDailyLog connects these three source roles with stateful CVE tracking and explicit source-health and publication limits. Inspect its implementation and timing evidence instead of treating this portfolio description as a live result.

workflows.title: Cloud identity: authentication is not permission
workflows.question: Which documentation should I use for a cloud access problem before changing a policy?
steps: Name the platform, principal, intended action and resource. Separate a failed sign-in or MFA challenge from an authenticated principal being denied a resource action.

For an AWS permission question, start with AWS IAM documentation. Identify the applicable account, policy types and conditions before reasoning about access; a single allow statement is not the whole decision.

For Microsoft Entra sign-in or authentication-method questions, use Microsoft documentation. Check tenant configuration, licensing and the method actually enabled; this does not establish authorisation to an application resource.
Reproduce the specific question with sanitised local evidence or an owner-approved test account. Keep production policy changes outside this source-selection exercise.
workflows.do_not_infer: Successful MFA is not proof of least privilege, and reading a guide is not evidence that an AWS account or Entra tenant is securely configured.
workflows.project_connection: The portfolio labels cloud work as foundations and learning, without claiming professional cloud-security employment or a verified production tenant. This workflow supplies a decision boundary, not a cloud audit result.

workflows.title: Web debugging: specification, explanation, deployment
workflows.question: An HTTP response looks wrong. Which source can explain what, and what must I measure myself?
steps: Capture the actual request method, response status and relevant headers without visitor cookies or authorisation values. Distinguish the origin response from cache or proxy behaviour.
Use RFC 9110 for normative method, status and header semantics. Use MDN for a readable explanation, while preserving the distinction between a reference guide and the standard.
For a deployment using Cloudflare, consult the vendor cache documentation for the exact rule and product context. Do not assume that a vendor feature or default applies to GitHub Pages.
Compare the rendered canonical URL, cache headers and content type at each hosting target. Shared UI source does not make GitHub Pages and a Sites Worker operationally identical.
workflows.do_not_infer: A 404 identifies a response outcome, not its root cause. A passing source test or build is not proof of production headers, indexing or cache behaviour.
workflows.project_connection: This portfolio shares content across a GitHub Pages static export and a separate Sites Worker. Its architecture and CSP source show the intended controls; each deployed target still requires independent verification.

workflows.title: Economic data: compare definitions before values
workflows.question: Can I compare two official European economic observations and interpret a trend?
steps: Start at Eurostat, then identify the specific dataset code and its metadata. Record the indicator definition, geography, units and frequency rather than citing only the portal homepage.
Check reference periods, nominal versus real values, seasonal adjustment and publication/revision dates. Resolve these differences before plotting series together.
Preserve status flags, missing observations and revisions. Record the actual extraction time and the dataset reuse terms; do not fill gaps silently or label old observations live.
Separate the observed series from the economic interpretation. Explain assumptions and uncertainty before connecting a movement with a business-cycle hypothesis.
workflows.do_not_infer: Official data alone does not establish causality, produce an investment recommendation or validate a particular economic theory.
workflows.project_connection: Austrian Business Cycle Monitor illustrates a separate interpretation layer with visible provenance, freshness and fallback states. This Eurostat selection example does not claim that Eurostat is an implemented data provider in that project.
